component.name: Mawjac
component.summary: IPTV player for M3U playlists, XMLTV guides, Tunarr and ErsatzTV

description.p: Mawjac plays live channels from M3U playlists and shows a rich programme guide from XMLTV. It works with Tunarr and ErsatzTV by just entering the server address.
Arabic and English with full right-to-left support, favourites, search, a zoomable guide timeline, and several themes including AMOLED.
